title: Advanced Proficiency in English as a Second Language
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 8S/12Q to fewer than 16S/24Q units

program.section_heading: Advanced Proficiency in English as a Second Language Certificate
outcomes: recognize cultural practices common to workplace situations in the United States.
demonstrate communication skills necessary in the workplace.
employ a variety of active reading strategies and adjust reading speed appropriately to address a full range of reading tasks including reading for inferences and bias.
analyze and evaluate a variety of texts.
cite outside sources correctly by using quotations, paraphrases, and summaries in writing assignments.
compose and edit clear, well-developed, and organized essays on academic topics.
revise and edit to achieve clarity of ideas and correctness of grammar, punctuation, and mechanics.
use a variety of sentence types with sophisticated logical connectors.

notes: The closed list stores 'ESL114' (no space, units not stored); the catalog prints 'ESL 114 Career Communication Skills: Intermediate 3'. Treated as the same closed-list course, so catalog_addition is false.
The Student Learning Outcomes list continues across the page break from page 390 to page 391; the last two outcomes appear at the top of page 391.
